description: NaNdWFeO₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.91 Å. Nd is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.69 Å. W is bonded to six O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-35°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.09 Å. Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-35°. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.25 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Nd, one W, and one Fe atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Nd, one W, and one Fe atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Nd, one W, and one Fe atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Nd, one W, and one Fe atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Nd, one W, and one Fe atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONd₂FeW tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one W, and one Fe atom.
